title: Szukam pracy, słucham muzyki
note: C1 Block 5, unit 4 - the block's closer, and the unit that makes c1_which_case [235] buildable: with this commit every C1 governor named in the spine's Block 5 has shipped its data/case-map.json row. TWO ROWS ship here (verbs governing the Genitive; the Genitive object after a verbal noun). EVERY VERB IN THE UNIT IS ALREADY OWNED - szukam/szuka <- a2_work2 [79], slucham <- a2_phone_func [89], slucha <- b1_imperative_rule [125], ucze/uczy <- a2_sie [74]. That is the whole shape of the unit: the verbs are not new, the CASE THEY TAKE is, so nothing here is a paradigm and everything is a government fact. FIVE NEW STRINGS ONLY: muzyki, polskiego, obiadu, racji, prace. THE ANCHOR IS EXCEPTIONAL AND WAS VERIFIED, NOT ASSUMED: 'szukam pracy' is TAUGHT <- a2_work2 [79] AS A WHOLE CHUNK and is ALREADY this construction - the learner has been producing a Genitive-governing verb for 120 nodes without being told. That is the b2_verbal_nouns / c1_na_acc opener at its cleanest. THE DEMONSTRATION RUNS ON muzyka BECAUSE IT IS THE ONLY NOUN THAT CAN CARRY IT: muzyke is TAUGHT <- trunk_want_like_a1 [23] in 'Lubie muzyke', so Lubie muzyke against Slucham muzyki is ONE noun, TWO verbs, TWO cases, with the Accusative side already in the learner's mouth. praca cannot do this job - A SURPRISE THE POOL TURNED UP: prace, the Accusative of a noun live since leaf_places [31], is UNTAUGHT after 200 nodes. It is taught here (one string, the ordinary -a to -e Accusative owned since A1) so that 'Mam prace' against 'Szukam pracy' is sayable at all; flagged in C1-DIGEST batch 8 as a gap the pool found rather than a scope decision. TWO IOUs CLOSED, BOTH NAMED BY THE PACKS THAT WROTE THEM. (a) a2_sie [74] fenced 'ucze sie polskiego' BY NAME; polskiego is derivable now that b2_adj_gen [137] owns -ego, and slide 4 makes the point that a Polish language name IS an adjective, contrasting the frozen 'po polsku' (TAUGHT <- a2_countries [71]) with the declined polskiego. (b) b2_verbal_nouns [175] called GENITIVE OBJECTS AFTER A VERBAL NOUN 'the significant scope cut' and named gotowanie obiadu and sluchanie muzyki. All six of its verbal nouns are owned, so slide 5 pays that fence with gotowanie obiadu, kupowanie chleba and robienie kawy - and chleba <- b2_neg_gen [162] and kawy <- a1_gen_endings [32] mean only obiadu is new. sluchanie itself is NOT taught: it is a seventh verbal noun and the fence is paid by the six that exist. INBOX ITEM 12 CLOSED: racji, fenced by name in b2_discussion_func and b1_opinions. 'mam racje' and 'masz racje' are TAUGHT <- b1_opinions [128] as whole chunks, so slide 6 is the negation rule b2_neg_gen [162] already owns meeting a chunk the learner already says - mam racje becomes nie mam racji, and the only new thing is the form. HOMOGRAPH DISCIPLINE: gazety is TAUGHT but AGENTS names it as one of the four nominative plurals that would be read as Genitive singulars, so it appears NOWHERE in this pack despite being an obvious 'listening to / looking for' object. ksiazki is used only in its Genitive-singular job (a1_gen_ki [39]), never as the a1_negation plural. mamy and gory are absent, as in both earlier units of this batch. DISTRACTOR LEGALITY CHECKED FORM BY FORM: muzyce, obiedzie, obiady, polskie, praca-Instrumental and racja were ALL rejected as NEW and replaced; every surviving choice is taught - praca <- leaf_places [31], muzyka/muzyke <- trunk_want_like_a1 [23], polski/polska/polsku <- a2_countries [71], obiad/chleb/mleko <- leaf_food_a1 [11], czas <- leaf_time_cal_a1 [37], kawa/kawe/kawy owned since A1. REFUSED AND LOGGED: potrzebowac, uzywac and bac sie - the three other everyday Genitive-governing verbs - are each a whole new paradigm, are named nowhere in C1-SPINE, and are therefore out of the level's scope; C1 is the last level, so C1-DIGEST batch 8 flags them as permanently untaught unless James rules otherwise. intro.title: You have been doing this since A2 without being told
intro.body:
Szukam pracy was handed to you whole in the work unit, and nothing was said about why it is pracy rather than praca.

It is the Genitive. A small group of Polish verbs take the Genitive where English simply puts an object after the verb, and szukać is one of them. You have been producing the construction for over a hundred lessons.

This unit names it and gives you the other two you need.

intro.title: One noun, two verbs, two cases
intro.body:
This is the cleanest way to see it, because both halves are already yours.

Lubię muzykę — the Accusative, the ending you have put on feminine nouns since A1.

Słucham muzyki — the Genitive, because słuchać is the second verb on the list.

The noun has not changed its meaning and the sentence has not changed its shape. The verb alone decided the ending, and that is the whole point of the unit: with these verbs you cannot reason from the English, because English gives both of them a plain object.

intro.title: The three verbs
intro.body:
These are the ones worth having. All three verbs are already yours — only the case after them is new.

szukać — to look for. Szukam pracy.

słuchać — to listen to. Słucham muzyki.

uczyć się — to learn. Uczę się polskiego.

There are a few more verbs in this group, and they are learned one at a time as you meet them, the way the na-places were.

intro.title: polskiego — the language is an adjective
intro.body:
You already say Mówię po polsku. That is a frozen phrase and nothing in it moves.

But polski is an adjective — the same word as in polska kawa — and when a language is the object of a verb, the adjective declines like any other. Uczę się polskiego uses the -ego you met on dobrego and nowego.

So two shapes sit side by side and neither is wrong: po polsku for how you speak, polskiego for what you are learning.
intro.body_pl: mówię po polsku · uczę się polskiego

intro.title: The -nie nouns take it too
intro.body:
When you turned verbs into nouns — gotowanie, kupowanie, robienie — you were given them on their own, with nothing after them. This is what goes after them.

A verbal noun is a noun, so what it acts on cannot be an object any more. It goes into the Genitive: gotowanie obiadu, kupowanie chleba, robienie kawy.

Compare the two halves. Gotuję obiad is a verb with an ordinary object. Gotowanie obiadu is a noun with a Genitive after it — the cooking of the dinner.
intro.body_pl: gotowanie obiadu · kupowanie chleba · robienie kawy

intro.title: And negation does it to everything
intro.body:
You already know that negating a verb turns its object into a Genitive: Mam chleb becomes Nie mam chleba.

That rule reaches the phrases you learned whole, too. Mam rację — I'm right — has an Accusative in it, and the moment it is negated the Accusative goes: Nie mam racji.

Nothing new is happening. It is the negation rule you have had since B2, meeting a phrase you have said since B1.
